hooks.command: npm run lint 2>&1 >/tmp/.meccg-lint-check.log; rc=$?; cat /tmp/.meccg-lint-check.log >&2; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Lint failed — fix errors before pushing"}}\n'; exit $rc
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.md$' && npm run lint:md 2>&1 || true; }
